thread:
Priya - PMM: Quick thought — can we create a compact 1-page "secure serving" brief for the field? Need something that covers: security posture, SLA expectations, deployment-mode decision flow, and two benchmark callouts for latency/cost. Low-effort, high-signal for Q2 launches.
Evan - Growth: Love it. Suggest 1 pager + an abbreviated 3-slide pack for demos and a single benchmark graphic we can reuse in social posts/webinar landing.
Jonas - Solutions Eng: Important to be precise on the SLA language. We should not promise specific ms unless we qualify by model/region. Maybe phrase as "typical p50/p95 on Redwood Dedicated for standard LLMs" and link to benchmark appendix.
Leah - Field Sales: Routing ask — can we add a simple inbound triage suggestion? Like: if customer asks for govcloud/VPC -> route to enterprise queue; if just latency questions -> send to sales + SRE demo. That helps AE prioritization.
Marta - Design: I can do a clean single-sheet layout that has 3 columns: Security (left), SLA + metrics (center), Deploy modes + routing (right). Need copy by EOD Friday to mock.
Priya - PMM: Draft copy idea (short):
• One-line value: "Predictable, secure inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
• Security: SOC2, KMS integrations, VPC peering, audit logs, optional on-prem package.
• SLA: "Committed uptime + latency SLOs for Dedicated; documented best-effort baselines for Hosted. See appendix for p50/p95 samples."
• Deploy modes: quick bullets + routing recommendations for field.
Evan - Growth: For the benchmark callouts, pick two real workload examples: chat prod (8k tokens, p95 latency target) and embeddings bulk (batch throughput + cost/unit). We'll call out % cost delta when using caching/quantization.
Jonas - Solutions Eng: Example snippets we can include (short):
```
SLA example: Dedicated: 99.9% uptime, p95 < 220ms (model: redwood-7b-v1, 512 tokens)
Hosted: best-effort p95 ~ 350-600ms depending on model/length
```
(We should add a caveat line: "Measured on typical N.Vidia A100 pools; actual may vary by region and model.")
Leah - Field Sales: Also include quick rebuttals for compliance buyers: "Private deployment supports KMS/HSM and audit log export; on-prem available for air-gapped requirements." Short bullets work.
Priya - PMM: Webinar tie-in: short 20-minute webinar + 10-min live Q&A. Title idea: "Serving LLMs at Scale: secure, predictable, and cost-conscious." Use benchmark graphic in slide 2 and a one-pager PDF as CTA. Who can host tech demo? @Jonas?
Jonas - Solutions Eng: I can demo Dedicated vs Hosted latency differences and show routing fallback in the console. Need ~30 min prep.
Marta - Design: For the CTA, I'll design a button "Get the one-pager + benchmark" that opens an inbound form. Please confirm form fields.
Leah - Field Sales: Form routing rules: if region == Gov/Regulated OR mentions: "HIPAA", "FedRAMP", "SOC2" -> route to enterprise-inbound queue; if request includes "pilot" OR "POC" -> route to AE queue; else -> growth nurture. Also add checkbox for "need on-prem".
Priya - PMM: Perfect. Action items:
- Priya: finalize copy + benchmark callouts (tomorrow noon)
- Jonas: supply latency/cost numbers and short CLI snippets for appendix (tomorrow)
- Marta: first mock of one-pager (EOD Friday)
- Evan: draft webinar landing + social blurbs (Friday)
- Leah: configure inbound routing rules with ops (next week)
Evan - Growth: For social/webinar promos, short options:
- Tweet-sized: "New brief: secure serving for enterprise — SLAs, deploy modes, benchmarks. Join our webinar."
- LinkedIn: longer highlight with 1 benchmark graphic and CTA.
Priya - PMM: Quick copy for the one-pager header to iterate on: "Secure, reliable LLM inference — choose the deployment that fits your compliance and latency needs." Feedback?
Leah - Field Sales: That reads well. Maybe swap "choose the deployment" -> "deployments that fit" for active tone.
Marta - Design: I'll iterate both header variants in the mock.
deploy-bot: New resource stub created -> https://redwood.internal/docs/marketing/secure-serving-brief-draft (editable).
Priya - PMM: Great. Final note: keep it consumable — field should be able to send this to a buyer in one email. If we can land a single-page PDF + slide and a short landing form with routing rules, we'll be set for the Q2 push. :rocket:
Evan - Growth: I'll block a 30-min sync Monday to review mock and landing.
Jonas - Solutions Eng: I'll bring test results and two short CLI examples for the appendix.
Leah - Field Sales: I'll draft the inbound routing playbook and send to ops for implementation.
Priya - PMM: Thanks all — will post copy in the doc and @everyone when ready for final review.
